questions.text: Do you maintain a formal, approved information security program and policy reviewed at least annually?
Are formal risk assessments performed at least annually and upon significant change?
Do you hold a current SOC 2 Type II attestation? If yes, state the trust services criteria covered and period.
Is your organization ISO/IEC 27001 certified? Provide certificate number and expiry.
Has an independent penetration test of the application been performed in the last 12 months? Summarize scope and outcome.
Do all production code changes require peer review and automated security testing (SAST/dependency scanning) before release?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all workforce access to production and corporate systems?
Are user access rights reviewed on a defined cadence, and is access revoked promptly on termination?
Is customer data encrypted in transit? Specify minimum protocol versions.
Is customer data encrypted at rest? Specify algorithms and key management approach.
Within how many days of contract termination is customer data deleted from your systems, including backups?
Do you maintain a published subprocessor list with advance notice of changes?
Where is customer data hosted (provider and regions)?
Are audit logs centrally collected, protected from tampering, and monitored for anomalous activity?
Do you have a documented incident response plan, and within what timeframe are customers notified of a confirmed breach?
Is the incident response plan tested at least annually? State the date of the most recent exercise.
State your RTO and RPO for production services and the date of your most recent DR test.
Do all employees complete security awareness training at hire and annually?
Are background checks performed for new hires where legally permitted?
What are your remediation SLAs for critical and high vulnerabilities?
Are company endpoints centrally managed with anti-malware, disk encryption, and enforced patching?
Do you assess the security posture of critical third parties/subprocessors?
Will Vendor contractually commit to unlimited liability for any security breach and guarantee a 99.99% uptime SLA with financial penalties?
Do you support verified deletion (certificate of deletion) on customer request?
